hyperparameters.diagnosis: dermlip+metadata14, unbalanced LR C=100.0, operating point {'SK': 0.5, 'MISC': 0.7}

boundaries.note: Deterministic re-derivation of the frozen promoted configuration already evaluated on TEST in perception_phase2_safety_preserving.json. Nothing is selected here; the script refuses to emit unless it exactly reproduces both the promoted read and the frozen pre-promotion references.

melanoma_auroc.source: promoted diagnosis head raw MEL posterior (AUROC-invariant to the operating point)

calibration.confidence_source: raw promoted-head posterior mass on the operating-point label (what run_cohort(promoted=True) writes into contracts); UNCALIBRATED
calibration.honesty_note: The pre-promotion calibration figures (ECE 0.0455) used a temperature-calibrated confidence from perception_baseline.json; no calibration has been fit for the promoted head, so these are raw-posterior diagnostics and not directly comparable to the calibrated base figure.

classifier_alone.note: Melanoma flag identical at argmax and at the SK/MISC operating point (asserted): re-ranking SK/MISC never touches the MEL column.

criteria_alone.auroc_note: No AUROC: 'seven-point score >= threshold 3' is a binary rule, not a ranked score.

union_rule.auroc_note: No AUROC: OR of two binary flags, not a ranked score.

union_sensitivity_gain.note: Union minus classifier melanoma sensitivity on the same 395 cases; paired case-level bootstrap. The decision-relevant statistic the two-view design is accepted on.

union_sensitivity_delta_vs_base_union.note: Promoted union minus PRE-promotion union sensitivity, paired on the same cases.

disclosed_specificity_cost: Union melanoma specificity falls 0.8503 (base) -> 0.6973 (promoted): the balanced criteria heads raise false positives along with true positives. Disclosed, not hidden -- the architecture surfaces the disagreement for human adjudication, and on a melanoma CDSS a missed melanoma dominates a benign false alarm.

base_arm_reference.label: PRE-PROMOTION arms (dermlip 512-d readers, argmax), reproduced exactly
